meta.title: Daily Page — About
meta.description: What Daily Page is, how it works, and why it was built as a slower, kinder corner of the web.

about.title: About Daily Page
about.tagline: A little room to think and write.

mission.p1: An indie writing lab—started in my living room, fueled by reader curiosity.
mission.p2: A place to take your time with words, share what’s on your mind, and write anonymously if you prefer.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.text: are shared spaces for writing and reading about a particular topic.

blocks.label: Posts
blocks.text: are collaborative writing spaces—anyone (even “anonymous”) can create one, edit it until it’s locked, and vote on others.

quests.label: Community Quests
quests.text: turn shared goals into guided writing projects, with claimable items, review, progress, and badges.

privacy.label: Privacy & Sharing
privacy.text: means public posts live in the room’s feed. Unlisted drafts hide until locked, but you get a share-link to invite friends.

markdown.label: Markdown & Media
markdown.text: lets you write in markdown, embed images, and co-edit like in Google Docs.

trends.label: Trends & Tags
trends.text: let you tag your post, track tag trends, and discover top content (7 d / 30 d / all-time).

streaks.label: Streaks
streaks.text: help you build a regular writing habit.

origin.p1: In 2018, I built a date-based wiki for “today’s page” and watched a few introspective writers turn it into an outlet for their thoughts. It never got huge—but it planted a seed.
origin.p2: Fast-forward to now, and Daily Page is that seed grown into many rooms—a quiet social web for introverts, idealists, and anyone craving a slower pace.

next.p1: We’re just getting started: richer embeds, deeper user stats, reputation leaderboards, and more ways to reward thoughtful creation.
next.p2: Thank you for being part of this little indie experiment.
